## Scores sanity checks

### par type de paire

```{r}


rank_all_df %>%
  mutate(pair_type = paste(type_feature, type_target, sep="×")) %>%
  group_by(pair_type) %>%
  summarize(
    rho_mi_u       = cor(mi, theil_u, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    rho_mi_cramer  = cor(mi, cramer_v, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    rho_u_cramer   = cor(theil_u, cramer_v, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    rho_poly_u     = cor(polychor, theil_u, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    n = n()
  )

```

### effet de la taille effective

```{r}
rank_all_df %>%
  mutate(n_bin = ntile(n_eff, 5)) %>%
  group_by(n_bin) %>%
  summarize(
    rho_mi_u = cor(mi, theil_u, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    rho_u_cv = cor(theil_u, cramer_v, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    rho_poly_u = cor(polychor, theil_u, use="pairwise.complete.obs", method="spearman"),
    n = n()
  )

```

### versios normalsiée

```{r}
safe_entropy <- function(p){ p <- p[p>0]; -sum(p*log2(p)) }
H_col <- function(x){ tab <- table(x); safe_entropy(prop.table(tab)) }

rank_all_df2 <- rank_all_df %>%
  mutate(
    # si tu as H(feature) / H(target) dans tes calculs de Theil’s U, réutilise-les
    su = 2*mi / (H_col(feature) + H_col(target))  # attention: ici H_col() ne prend pas les données brutes;
                                                  # l'exemple illustre la formule, à adapter au contexte de calcul MI
  )

```

### réduire redondance du score

```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(recipes)

rec <- recipe(~ theil_u + cramer_v + polychor, data = rank_all_df) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_predictors(), num_comp = 1) %>%
  prep()

rank_all_df$assoc_pc1 <- bake(rec, new_data = NULL)[[1]]

```

### score latent pca

```{r}
library(tidymodels)

rec <- recipe(~ theil_u + cramer_v + polychor, data = rank_all_df) %>%
  step_impute_median(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_normalize(all_predictors()) %>%
  step_pca(all_predictors(), num_comp = 3)

prep_rec <- prep(rec)
pca_obj  <- tidy(prep_rec, number = 3)       # loadings
expl_var <- tidy(prep_rec, number = 3, type = "variance") # variance expliquée

# PC1 comme score
rank_all_df$assoc_pc1 <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = NULL)[["PC1"]]
```

# Calcul de scores d'importance des features

```{r}
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  Feature ranking par cible (MI, Cramér’s V, Polychor/Tetra, Theil’s U)
#  - Détection ordinale stricte (Likert >=3 ou binaire Yes/No)
#  - Mapping t_Qxxx -> Qxxx pour récupérer les niveaux (metadata/JSON)
#  - Rangs par métrique + score composite
#  - Exports: CSV (par cible & ALL) + JSON (Top-N par cible pour LLM)
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(arrow)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(stringr)
  library(infotheo)   # MI
  library(jsonlite)   # JSON items
  library(polycor)    # polychor/tetrachor
})

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b

# ── 0) Chemins & lecture ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
meta_path  <- "data/metadata.parquet"
train_path <- "data/train.parquet"

# JSON: essaie /mnt/data puis data/
wvs_json_candidate <- c("/mnt/data/wvs_answer_categories_VERBATIM.json",
                        "data/wvs_answer_categories_VERBATIM.json")
wvs_json_path <- wvs_json_candidate[file.exists(wvs_json_candidate)][1] %||% NA_character_

metadata <- arrow::read_parquet(meta_path) %>% as_tibble()
train    <- arrow::read_parquet(train_path) %>% as_tibble()

dir.create("exports", showWarnings = FALSE)

targets      <- names(train) %>% keep(~ str_starts(.x, "t_"))
features_all <- names(train) %>% setdiff(c(targets, "respondent_id"))

# ── 1) Normalisation / canonisation ────────────────────────────────────────────
na_tokens <- c(
  "No answer","Don't know","Don’t know","Don´t know","DK","Refused","Missing",
  "Hard to say","Don’t mind","Don´t mind","Other answer"
)

normalize_txt <- function(v) {
  v %>%
    str_replace_all("[`´’]", "'") %>%
    str_replace_all("\\s+", " ") %>%
    str_trim()
}

canon_map <- c(
  # accords
  "Agree strongly"="Strongly agree",
  "Disagree strongly"="Strongly disagree",
  "Neither agree or disagree"="Neither agree nor disagree",
  # fréquences
  "Very Frequently"="Very often",
  "Quite frequently"="Fairly often",
  "Not at all frequently"="Not at all often",
  # satisfactions
  "Completely Satisfied"="Completely satisfied",
  "Completely Dissatisfied"="Completely dissatisfied"
)

canonize <- function(x){
  x2 <- normalize_txt(as.character(x))
  if (!length(x2)) return(x2)
  m <- match(x2, names(canon_map))
  repl <- !is.na(m)
  x2[repl] <- unname(canon_map[m[repl]])
  x2
}

# Patrons Likert + binaire
LIKERT_4_IMPORTANCE <- c("Not at all important","Not very important","Rather important","Very important")
LIKERT_5_AGREE      <- c("Strongly disagree","Disagree","Neither agree nor disagree","Agree","Strongly agree")
LIKERT_5_FREQ       <- c("Never","Rarely","Sometimes","Often","Very often")
LIKERT_5_SAT        <- c("Very dissatisfied","Dissatisfied","Neither agree nor disagree","Satisfied","Very satisfied")
LIKERT_4_TRUST      <- c("None at all","Not very much","Trust somewhat","Trust completely")

ord_patterns_likert <- list(
  LIKERT_4_IMPORTANCE, LIKERT_5_AGREE, LIKERT_5_FREQ, LIKERT_5_SAT, LIKERT_4_TRUST,
  c("Not at all often","Not often","Fairly often","Very often"),
  c("No risk at all","Low risk","Moderate risk","High risk","Very high risk")
)
binary_patterns <- list(c("No","Yes"), c("Yes","No"))

is_subset_of_any <- function(levs, patterns) any(purrr::map_lgl(patterns, ~ all(levs %in% .x)))
ordered_levels_from_patterns <- function(levs, patterns){
  pats <- purrr::keep(patterns, ~ all(levs %in% .x))
  if (length(pats)) pats[[1]][pats[[1]] %in% levs] else NULL
}
classify_levels <- function(levs){
  if (is_subset_of_any(levs, ord_patterns_likert))
    return(list(kind="likert", ord_levels = ordered_levels_from_patterns(levs, ord_patterns_likert)))
  if (is_subset_of_any(levs, binary_patterns))
    return(list(kind="binary", ord_levels = ordered_levels_from_patterns(levs, binary_patterns)))
  list(kind="nominal", ord_levels=NULL)
}

# ── 2) Niveaux depuis metadata + (option) JSON ─────────────────────────────────
meta_levels <- metadata %>%
  transmute(
    question_id = as.character(question_id),
    levels_vec  = map(answer_categories, ~ as.character(.x))
  )

if (!is.na(wvs_json_path)) {
  json_raw <- jsonlite::fromJSON(wvs_json_path, simplifyVector = FALSE)
  json_tbl <- tibble(
    question_id = names(json_raw),
    levels_vec  = map(json_raw, ~ as.character(.x$levels) %||% character())
  )
  meta_levels <- meta_levels %>%
    full_join(json_tbl, by = "question_id", suffix = c("_meta","_json")) %>%
    mutate(
      levels_vec = case_when(
        map_int(levels_vec_meta, length) > 0 ~ levels_vec_meta,
        map_int(levels_vec_json, length) > 0 ~ levels_vec_json,
        TRUE                                 ~ list(character())
      )
    ) %>%
    select(question_id, levels_vec)
}

meta_levels <- meta_levels %>%
  mutate(levels_vec = map(levels_vec, ~ setdiff(canonize(.x), na_tokens)))

strip_t <- function(x) ifelse(str_starts(x, "t_"), str_replace(x, "^t_", ""), x)

meta_types <- meta_levels %>%
  mutate(
    cls = map(levels_vec, classify_levels),
    kind = map_chr(cls, "kind"),
    ord_levels = map(cls, "ord_levels")
  ) %>%
  transmute(question_id, kind, ord_levels)

meta_lookup <- meta_types %>%
  mutate(key2 = strip_t(question_id)) %>%
  select(question_id, key2, kind, ord_levels)

get_meta_kind_levels <- function(var){
  d1 <- meta_lookup %>% filter(question_id == var)
  if (nrow(d1)==1) return(list(kind=d1$kind, ord_levels=d1$ord_levels[[1]]))
  base <- strip_t(var)
  d2 <- meta_lookup %>% filter(question_id == base | key2 == base)
  if (nrow(d2)>=1) return(list(kind=d2$kind[1], ord_levels=d2$ord_levels[[1]]))
  list(kind="nominal", ord_levels=NULL)
}

detect_from_data <- function(x_chr){
  vals <- setdiff(unique(canonize(x_chr)), na_tokens)
  if (!length(vals)) return(list(kind="nominal", ord_levels=NULL))
  classify_levels(vals)
}

# ── 3) Encodage (ordered seulement si kind ∈ {likert, binary}) ────────────────
cols_categ <- setdiff(names(train), "respondent_id")
train_chr  <- train %>% mutate(across(all_of(cols_categ), ~ canonize(.x)))

encode_one_col <- function(colname, vec_chr){
  meta <- get_meta_kind_levels(colname)
  kind <- meta$kind; levs <- meta$ord_levels
  if (kind == "nominal" || is.null(levs) || !length(levs)) {
    det <- detect_from_data(vec_chr); kind <- det$kind; levs <- det$ord_levels
  }
  x <- vec_chr; x[x %in% na_tokens] <- NA_character_
  if (kind %in% c("likert","binary") && !is.null(levs) && length(levs)>0) {
    factor(x, levels = levs, ordered = TRUE)
  } else {
    factor(x)
  }
}

train_fct <- train_chr %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(cols_categ), ~ encode_one_col(cur_column(), .x)))

ordinal_vars <- names(train_fct)[map_lgl(train_fct, is.ordered)]
nominal_vars <- setdiff(names(train_fct), c(ordinal_vars, "respondent_id"))

cat("Nombre de cibles:", length(targets), "\n")
cat("Variables ordinales détectées (dans train):", length(ordinal_vars), "\n")
targets_ord <- intersect(targets, ordinal_vars)
cat("Targets ordinales détectées:", length(targets_ord), " / ", length(targets), "\n")
if (length(targets_ord)) print(targets_ord)

# ── 4) Mesures d’association ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
min_n <- 100  # garde-fou
top_k <- 30   # export CSV top-K par cible
topN  <- 15   # export JSON top-N pour prompts

# MI
safe_mutual_information <- function(x, y) {
  xx <- as.integer(droplevels(x)); yy <- as.integer(droplevels(y))
  ok <- !is.na(xx) & !is.na(yy); xx <- xx[ok]; yy <- yy[ok]
  if (length(xx) < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(tryCatch(infotheo::mutinformation(xx, yy), error = function(e) NA_real_))
}
# Cramér’s V
safe_cramers_v <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  tab <- table(droplevels(x[ok]), droplevels(y[ok]))
  if (any(dim(tab) < 2)) return(NA_real_)
  k <- min(nrow(tab)-1, ncol(tab)-1); if (k <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(tryCatch({
    chi2 <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)$statistic
    sqrt(as.numeric(chi2) / (n * k))
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_))
}
# Polychor/Tetra (selon cardinalités)
safe_poly_assoc <- function(x, y) {
  if (!(is.ordered(x) && is.ordered(y))) return(NA_real_)
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); n <- sum(ok)
  if (n < min_n) return(NA_real_)
  x2 <- droplevels(x[ok]); y2 <- droplevels(y[ok])
  nx <- nlevels(x2); ny <- nlevels(y2)
  if (nx < 2 || ny < 2) return(NA_real_)
  suppressWarnings(tryCatch({
    if (nx == 2 && ny == 2) {
      polycor::tetrachoric(table(x2, y2))$rho
    } else {
      polycor::polychor(x2, y2, ML = TRUE)
    }
  }, error = function(e) NA_real_))
}

# Theil’s U : U(Y|X) = (H(Y) - H(Y|X)) / H(Y)
safe_entropy <- function(p) { p <- p[p > 0]; if (!length(p)) return(0); -sum(p * log2(p)) }
entropy_from_counts <- function(counts) { tot <- sum(counts); if (tot == 0) return(0); safe_entropy(counts/tot) }
conditional_entropy_y_given_x <- function(tab_xy) {
  n <- sum(tab_xy); if (n == 0) return(0)
  hx <- apply(tab_xy, 1, entropy_from_counts)   # H(Y|X=x)
  px <- rowSums(tab_xy) / n
  sum(px * hx)                                  # H(Y|X)
}
theils_U_y_given_x <- function(x, y) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- droplevels(x[ok]); y <- droplevels(y[ok])
  if (length(x) < 2 || length(y) < 2) return(NA_real_)
  tab <- table(x, y)
  hy  <- entropy_from_counts(colSums(tab))
  if (hy == 0) return(NA_real_)                 # Y dégénéré
  hyx <- conditional_entropy_y_given_x(tab)
  as.numeric((hy - hyx) / hy)                   # U(Y|X)
}

# ── 5) Ranking par cible ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
all_ranks <- list()

for (tq in targets) {
  y <- train_fct[[tq]]
  target_is_ordinal <- is.ordered(y)

  res <- purrr::map_dfr(features_all, function(fq){
    if (!fq %in% names(train_fct)) return(NULL)
    x <- train_fct[[fq]]

    ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
    n_eff <- sum(ok)
    if (n_eff < min_n) {
      return(tibble(
        target = tq, feature = fq, n_eff = n_eff,
        mi = NA_real_, cramer_v = NA_real_, polychor = NA_real_, theil_u = NA_real_,
        type_feature = if_else(is.ordered(x), "ordinal", "nominal"),
        type_target  = if_else(target_is_ordinal, "ordinal", "nominal")
      ))
    }

    mi_val   <- safe_mutual_information(x, y)
    cv_val   <- safe_cramers_v(x, y)
    polyval  <- if (target_is_ordinal && is.ordered(x)) safe_poly_assoc(x, y) else NA_real_
    theil_u  <- theils_U_y_given_x(x, y)   # *** U(Target|Feature) ***

    tibble(
      target = tq, feature = fq, n_eff = n_eff,
      mi = as.numeric(mi_val),
      cramer_v = as.numeric(cv_val),
      polychor = as.numeric(polyval),
      theil_u = as.numeric(theil_u),
      type_feature = if_else(is.ordered(x), "ordinal", "nominal"),
      type_target  = if_else(target_is_ordinal, "ordinal", "nominal")
    )
  })

  # Score composite (pragmatique) — favorise Theil’s U (asymétrique)
  res <- res %>%
    mutate(
      score = 0.6*coalesce(theil_u, 0) +
              0.3*coalesce(mi, 0) +
              0.1*coalesce(cramer_v, 0) +
              0.1*abs(coalesce(polychor, 0))
    ) %>%
    # Rangs par métrique (NA en fin)
    mutate(
      rank_theilU = min_rank(desc(coalesce(theil_u, -Inf))),
      rank_mi     = min_rank(desc(coalesce(mi, -Inf))),
      rank_cramer = min_rank(desc(coalesce(cramer_v, -Inf))),
      rank_poly   = min_rank(desc(coalesce(abs(polychor), -Inf))),
      rank_score  = min_rank(desc(coalesce(score, -Inf)))
    ) %>%
    arrange(rank_score, desc(score), desc(theil_u), desc(mi), desc(cramer_v), desc(abs(polychor))) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())   # rang global final (héritage historique)

  # Exports par cible
  readr::write_csv(res %>% slice_head(n = top_k),
                   file = file.path("exports", paste0("feature_ranking_", tq, ".csv")))
  all_ranks[[tq]] <- res
}

# Consolidé ALL
rank_all_df <- bind_rows(all_ranks)
readr::write_csv(rank_all_df, "exports/feature_ranking_ALL.csv")

# JSON Top-N (par défaut basé sur rank_score ; change si tu préfères theilU)
top_features <- rank_all_df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  arrange(rank_score, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  summarize(features = list(feature), .groups = "drop") %>%
  deframe()
write_json(top_features, "exports/top_features_by_target.json", auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE)

# ── 6) Résumé console ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n==== RÉSUMÉ ====\n")
cat("Nombre de cibles:", length(targets), "\n")
cat("Variables ordinales détectées (dans train):", length(ordinal_vars), "\n")
cat("Targets ordinales détectées:", length(targets_ord), " / ", length(targets), "\n\n")

rank_all_df %>%
  group_by(target) %>%
  arrange(rank_score, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  select(target, rank, rank_score, rank_theilU, rank_mi, rank_cramer, rank_poly,
         feature, n_eff, mi, cramer_v, polychor, theil_u, score, type_feature) %>%
  print(n = 200, width = Inf)

cat("\nFichiers écrits dans exports/ :\n",
    " - feature_ranking_ALL.csv (toutes les paires cible×feature)\n",
    " - feature_ranking_t_*.csv (Top", top_k, "par cible)\n",
    " - top_features_by_target.json (Top", topN, "features par cible, pour LLM)\n")

write.csv(rank_all_df, "rank_all_questions.csv")
write.csv(feature_pop, "most_popular_questions_features.csv")
write.csv(train, "train.csv")
```

## Sanity checks

```{r}
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SANITY CHECK (simple) — glmnet pénalisée vs baselines (majorité & chance)
# Requiert : train_fct, rank_all_df, targets
# Écrit : exports/sanity_check_<TARGET>.csv (une ligne par Target)
# ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(glmnet)
  library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(forcats); library(readr); library(purrr)
})

dir.create("exports", showWarnings = FALSE)
set.seed(42)

# == Paramètres ==
top_n_feats    <- 20           # Top-N features par Target (depuis rank_all_df)
train_frac     <- 0.80         # split 80/20
alpha_en       <- 0.5          # elastic-net (0=ridge, 1=lasso)
lambda_choice  <- "lambda.1se" # ou "lambda.min"
min_count_lump <- 20           # regrouper modalités rares (features)

# == Helpers ==
macro_f1 <- function(y_true, y_pred){
  `%||%` <- function(a,b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
  lev <- union(levels(y_true), levels(y_pred))
  y_true <- factor(as.character(y_true), levels = lev)
  y_pred <- factor(as.character(y_pred), levels = lev)
  tb <- table(y_true, y_pred)
  f1s <- sapply(lev, function(l){
    tp <- tb[l, l] %||% 0; fp <- sum(tb[, l]) - tp; fn <- sum(tb[l, ]) - tp
    if ((2*tp + fp + fn) == 0) return(NA_real_)
    2*tp / (2*tp + fp + fn)
  })
  mean(f1s, na.rm = TRUE)
}
log_loss_multi <- function(prob_mat, y_true){
  eps <- 1e-15
  classes <- colnames(prob_mat)
  y_true <- factor(as.character(y_true), levels = classes)
  idx <- match(as.character(y_true), classes)
  p <- prob_mat[cbind(seq_len(nrow(prob_mat)), idx)]
  p <- pmin(pmax(p, eps), 1 - eps)
  -mean(log(p))
}
brier_score_bin <- function(p1, y_true){
  lev <- levels(y_true)
  y <- as.integer(factor(as.character(y_true), levels = lev) == lev[2])
  mean((p1 - y)^2)
}

get_top_features <- function(tq, n = top_n_feats){
  rk <- if ("rank_score" %in% names(rank_all_df)) "rank_score" else "rank"
  rank_all_df %>% filter(target == tq) %>% arrange(.data[[rk]]) %>%
    slice_head(n = n) %>% pull(feature)
}

run_one <- function(tq){
  # 1) Data cible + Top-N
  feats <- get_top_features(tq, top_n_feats)
  if (!length(feats)) return(invisible(NULL))
  df <- train_fct %>%
    select(tidyselect::any_of(c(tq, feats))) %>%
    drop_na()
  if (nrow(df) < 50) return(invisible(NULL))

  # 2) Lumping des modalités rares sur les features (pas la cible)
  feat_cols <- setdiff(names(df), tq)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(feat_cols[map_lgl(df[feat_cols], is.factor)]),
                  ~ fct_lump_min(.x, min = min_count_lump, other_level = "__OTHER__"))) %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.ordered), ~ factor(.x))) %>%  # simplifie design
    droplevels()

  # 3) Split 80/20
  n <- nrow(df); idx <- sample.int(n, floor(train_frac*n))
  tr <- df[idx, , drop = FALSE]; te <- df[-idx, , drop = FALSE]

  # Cible (désordonnée + niveaux alignés)
  lev <- union(levels(tr[[tq]]), levels(te[[tq]]))
  y_tr <- factor(as.character(tr[[tq]]), levels = lev)
  y_te <- factor(as.character(te[[tq]]), levels = lev)

  # Baselines
  K <- nlevels(y_tr)
  maj <- names(sort(table(y_tr), decreasing = TRUE))[1]
  acc_majority <- mean(factor(maj, levels = lev)[rep(1, length(y_te))] == y_te)
  f1_majority  <- macro_f1(y_te, factor(rep(maj, length(y_te)), levels = lev))
  acc_chance   <- 1 / K  # baseline "au hasard" uniforme

  # 4) Design matrices (consistentes)
  tr$.split <- "train"; te$.split <- "test"
  all_m <- bind_rows(tr, te)
  fml_x <- as.formula(paste("~ . -", tq, "- .split - 1"))
  X <- model.matrix(fml_x, data = all_m)
  X_tr <- X[all_m$.split=="train", , drop=FALSE]
  X_te <- X[all_m$.split=="test",  , drop=FALSE]

  fam <- if (K == 2) "binomial" else "multinomial"

  # 5) Fit + prédiction
  cvfit <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(
    x = X_tr, y = y_tr,
    family = fam, alpha = alpha_en,
    nfolds = 5, type.measure = "deviance",
    type.multinomial = "ungrouped"
  )
  s_use <- if (lambda_choice %in% c("lambda.min","lambda.1se")) lambda_choice else "lambda.1se"

  if (fam == "binomial") {
    p1 <- as.numeric(predict(cvfit, newx = X_te, s = s_use, type = "response"))
    yhat <- ifelse(p1 >= 0.5, levels(y_tr)[2], levels(y_tr)[1]) %>%
      factor(levels = lev)
    acc <- mean(yhat == y_te)
    f1  <- macro_f1(y_te, yhat)
    brier <- brier_score_bin(p1, y_te)
    tibble(
      target = tq, n_train = length(y_tr), n_test = length(y_te),
      k_classes = K, top_n = length(feats),
      alpha = alpha_en, lambda = s_use, family = fam,
      acc_model = acc, f1_macro_model = f1, brier = brier,
      logloss = NA_real_,
      acc_majority = acc_majority, f1_majority = f1_majority, acc_chance = acc_chance
    )
  } else {
    pr <- predict(cvfit, newx = X_te, s = s_use, type = "response")  # n x K x 1
    pr_mat <- as.matrix(pr[,,1]); colnames(pr_mat) <- colnames(pr)
    # aligne colonnes-probas sur "lev" si besoin
    miss <- setdiff(lev, colnames(pr_mat))
    if (length(miss)) {
      pr_mat <- cbind(pr_mat, matrix(0, nrow(pr_mat), length(miss),
                                     dimnames = list(NULL, miss)))
    }
    pr_mat <- pr_mat[, lev, drop=FALSE]
    yhat <- apply(pr_mat, 1, function(r) lev[which.max(r)]) %>% factor(levels = lev)
    acc <- mean(yhat == y_te)
    f1  <- macro_f1(y_te, yhat)
    ll  <- log_loss_multi(pr_mat, y_te)
    tibble(
      target = tq, n_train = length(y_tr), n_test = length(y_te),
      k_classes = K, top_n = length(feats),
      alpha = alpha_en, lambda = s_use, family = fam,
      acc_model = acc, f1_macro_model = f1, brier = NA_real_,
      logloss = ll,
      acc_majority = acc_majority, f1_majority = f1_majority, acc_chance = acc_chance
    )
  }
}

# == Lancer pour chaque Target et écrire un CSV par cible ==
all_rows <- list()
for (tq in targets) {
  cat("[Sanity] ", tq, " ...\n")
  row <- tryCatch(run_one(tq), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(row)) {
    write_csv(row, file.path("exports", paste0("sanity_check_", tq, ".csv")))
    print(row %>% select(target, family, k_classes, top_n, acc_model, f1_macro_model,
                         acc_majority, acc_chance))
    all_rows[[tq]] <- row
  } else {
    message("  (skipped: not enough data or error)")
  }
}
# optionnel: consolidé
if (length(all_rows)) {
  bind_rows(all_rows) %>% write_csv("exports/sanity_checks_ALL.csv")
  cat("\nRésumé écrit : exports/sanity_checks_ALL.csv\n")
}

```

### quelles sont les features qui reviennent le plus souvent pour prédire la réponse

```{r}
# Paramètres
topN <- 20                           # combien de features par target on regarde
rkcol <- if ("rank_score" %in% names(rank_all_df)) "rank_score" else "rank"

# Top-N par target
top_tbl <- rank_all_df %>%
  dplyr::group_by(target) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.data[[rkcol]], .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Popularité + stats rapides
feature_pop <- top_tbl %>%
  dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    appearances      = dplyr::n(),                         # nb de targets où la feature est dans le Top-N
    targets_covered  = dplyr::n_distinct(target),
    coverage_rate    = targets_covered / dplyr::n_distinct(top_tbl$target),
    mean_rank        = mean(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_rank      = stats::median(rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_theil_u     = mean(theil_u, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_mi          = mean(mi, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_cramer_v    = mean(cramer_v, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_score       = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE),
    # “force” type Borda: plus la feature est haut dans le Top-N, plus elle marque
    strength_score   = sum(topN - rank + 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(appearances), dplyr::desc(strength_score), mean_rank)

# Aperçu console
print(feature_pop %>% dplyr::slice_head(n = 30), n = 30, width = Inf)

# Export
readr::write_csv(feature_pop, file.path("exports", paste0("feature_global_popularity_top", topN, ".csv")))

```
